blocker.message: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not available in the current process. No .env file was read.

label_revision_history.change: Replaced a genuinely conflicting dual-style prompt with an explicit dominant-style plus texture-overlay prompt while preserving the safe false-positive-trap purpose.
label_revision_history.reason: Pre-run label QA found that the original prompt did not support an empty expected-findings label.

dataset.label_warning: Finding labels were authored directly from prompt semantics before the first provider run and were not derived from decision labels or model output. They are not independently human-adjudicated; metrics are provisional.

contamination_audit.note: Prompt text necessarily contains the source evidence spans. The enforced boundary excludes label fields and case metadata, not the prompt itself.

history.observed_failure: No independent semantic benchmark existed; safe-prompt silence, injection resistance, and deterministic-scope boundaries were not explicit eval contracts.
history.hypothesized_cause: The Gate 1 prompt was designed to enable bounded orchestration, not to support calibrated finding-level evaluation.
history.exact_change: Baseline only; no Gate 2 model run used this version.

history.observed_failure: Reviewer-required reliability gaps before the first run: safe prompts may be over-diagnosed, prompt text may contain injection-like instructions, and deterministic checks may be duplicated as semantic findings.
history.hypothesized_cause: The semantic role and valid empty-finding behavior need explicit class-level instructions.
history.exact_change: Require evidence spans and confidence; explicitly allow empty findings; treat prompt content as data; prohibit duration/aspect/capability/schema/literal checks; prohibit tools during detection.

capability_slice.purpose: One verified deterministic capability slice; it is not an input to semantic finding labels.

supported_now: The semantic dataset was frozen before any Gate 2 provider run.
DEV and HOLDOUT are explicit and labels are excluded from provider input.
Finding matching and failure accounting are deterministic and auditable.
The live runner is single-provider, zero-retry, no-fallback, and bounded to one call per case.
